en.title: Send feedback
en.description: Tell us about a bug, a feature idea, how we’re doing, or anything else. We’ll get back to you within 10 working days.
en.ratingHelper: Optional — required if you chose Rating.
en.messagePlaceholder: What happened, or what would you like us to know?
en.emailGuestHint: We’ll use this to reply within 10 working days.
en.successDescription: Thanks — we received your feedback and will reply within 10 working days.
en.errorFallback: We could not send your feedback. Please try again.
en.rateLimited: You’ve sent too much feedback. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
en.rateLimitedGeneric: You’ve sent too much feedback. Please wait a bit and try again.

zh_hk.title: 傳送意見
zh_hk.description: 告訴我們程式錯誤、功能建議、使用體驗，或其他意見。我們會在 10 個工作天內回覆。
zh_hk.ratingHelper: 可選 — 若選擇「評分」則必須填寫。
zh_hk.messagePlaceholder: 發生了什麼事，或你希望我們知道什麼？
zh_hk.emailGuestHint: 我們會在 10 個工作天內回覆至此地址。
zh_hk.successDescription: 謝謝 — 我們已收到你的意見，並會在 10 個工作天內回覆。
zh_hk.errorFallback: 無法傳送意見，請再試一次。
zh_hk.rateLimited: 傳送次數過多。請在 {seconds} 秒後再試。
zh_hk.rateLimitedGeneric: 傳送次數過多。請稍後再試。
